metadata.title: Medical Device Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Defines governance responsibility for network-connected medical and clinical devices.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Regulated medical devices, clinical systems, and IoMT environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes clinical scope, intended use, and patient-safety context for medical devices.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Cybersecurity and operational controls must never compromise patient safety or continuity of care.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides threat context for cyber activity that could affect clinical outcomes or patient safety.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Maps defensive intent for visibility, classification, and safety-aware protection of medical devices.

metadata.remarks: Defines what constitutes a regulated medical device, establishes clinical risk classification, and records baseline safety assumptions that constrain cybersecurity and operational controls for IoMT environments.

components.title: Medical Device Identification
components.description: Identification and authoritative inventory of regulated medical and clinical devices connected to institutional networks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical devices are uniquely identified and associated with their intended clinical use and connectivity.

components.title: Clinical Risk Classification
components.description: Classification of medical devices based on potential patient harm and impact to care delivery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical devices are classified according to patient safety and clinical criticality.

components.title: Baseline Clinical Assumptions
components.description: Documentation of baseline clinical and safety assumptions governing medical device operation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Clinical and safety assumptions explicitly constrain operational and security controls.
